title: Are You Growing or Stuck? — 2 Peter 3:18
paragraphs: Are You Growing or Stuck? — 2 Peter 3:18

Some people call it “rest.”
But deep down, it’s drift.

Some call it “waiting on God.”
But really, they stopped pursuing Him.
Are you growing… or just getting older in church?
“But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be glory both now and forever! Amen.” — 2 Peter 3:18

Peter did not say stay inspired.
He said grow.

That means grace is not a hiding place for spiritual laziness.
Grace is the power that pulls you closer to Jesus.

You can attend services.
Post verses.
Say “God knows my heart.”
And still be stuck in the same pride, the same compromise, the same coldness.

Growth is not perfection.
Growth is repentance.
Growth is hunger.
Growth is letting Christ confront what you keep excusing.

A growing believer is not sinless.
But they are not settled in sin.
They do not play with darkness and call it maturity.
They keep coming back to the feet of Jesus.

Because the Gospel does not just forgive your past.
It transforms your present.

Jesus did not die and rise again so you could remain spiritually numb.
He came to save you fully.
To break what has been binding you.
To form His life in you.
To teach your heart to love holiness again.
So ask yourself with trembling honesty:

Am I growing in grace?
Am I growing in the knowledge of Christ?
Do I know Him more deeply now than I did before?
Or have I learned how to look alive while staying stuck?

Beloved, there is no shame in admitting you’ve been stagnant.
The danger is pretending you’re fine.

Today, Christ still calls dry hearts back.
Today, mercy still opens the door.
Today, the Holy Spirit still grows those who surrender.

You are not doomed to stay where you are.
In Jesus, stuck is not your final state.
